pairs.registryProposal: Clarify paused-sku-never-advertised: procedure steps 2-3 require filtering before a narrow consumer shape and excluding the pause flag, whereas its first decision rule requires that flag inside a narrow consumer input; distinguish trusted adapter outputs from unfiltered inputs.
